resources.validatity-app-para: To track the validity of your appointment, click below. Use the appointment reference number (ARN) and passport number provided in the appointment letter.
resources.maintenance.time: 10:00 PM IST to 20 April, 1:00 AM IST
resources.refund.update: No cancellation of appointment is allowed by the Government issuing visa and therefore no refund of Service fees shall be processed for cancellation of visa application.
resources.cancel-text: No cancellations are allowed for Poland in India as per local law, and service or value-added fees are non-refundable.
resources.extra-text1: This service may be availed online at the time of scheduling your appointment, or alternatively, it can be purchased in person during your visit to the VFS centre.
resources.text4: You can pay the visa fee at the visa application centre in Cash, Card and UPI.
